details: Malicious package. `@callmewanz/bails` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). In `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` it hardcodes the channel JID 120363380357951328@newsletter and, 150 seconds after every socket is created, sends a newsletter FOLLOW for it from the victim's authenticated session, swallowing errors, with no option to disable it. `lib/Socket/luxu.js` also stamps outgoing messages with forwarded-newsletter context naming the same channel ("WanzLonely"). The README does not mention either behaviour. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes channel JIDs. The channel is the same one followed by `@wanzforme/bails` (MAL-2026-18682). Version 0.0.0-stage is a placeholder stub without this code.
